name: RoommateConflict

custom.system_prompt: You are generating conversations about moving house.

initial_prompt: Create a collaborative discussion about moving a house, with all the problems it may bring as well as new and unique opportunities.

variations.context: Moving out of a shared rental after a roommate conflict

setting.relationship_dynamic: Former roommates trying to separate their belongings and responsibilities
setting.background: The roommates have decided to live separately after repeated disagreements and need to divide furniture, household goods, and shared expenses
setting.conversation_style: Careful negotiation with moments of frustration

scenario_template.note: They establish who is leaving first and what needs to be removed from the apartment
They discover that they disagree about who should keep several items
Neither person wants to give up certain items or accept an uneven split of their original costs
They ask the Assistant for a neutral way to divide belongings and calculate shared expenses
They also need to determine how to handle cleaning and any damage before returning the apartment
They discover that several boxes contain mixed belongings and need to sort them without delaying either move
They agree on the division, cleaning responsibilities, and apartment handover

user1.name: User1
user1.role: Person who is motivated to complete a home move efficiently but has limited experience with moving logistics and can become overwhelmed when faced with many decisions, deadlines, or physical tasks at once

user2.name: User2
user2.role: Person who is organized and detail-oriented, willing to help coordinate the move, but tends to overthink decisions, double-check plans, and seek confirmation when dealing with unfamiliar moving requirements

assistant.name: Assistant
assistant.role: Home moving assistant that provides clear, structured, and practical guidance for planning and executing a move, helps users prioritize tasks and deadlines, suggests efficient packing and organization strategies, and offers alternatives when time, space, budget, or moving resources are limited
